data.title: RED: REVIEW-DEFENSE auditor classifies each defense by status

content.text: **What**: Write failing tests for plugins/dso/scripts/audit-review-defenses.sh that scans plugins/dso/ for REVIEW-DEFENSE comments and classifies each as still-defended, stale, walking-skeleton-needs-followon-check, or test-context.
**Why**: SC-2, SC-3, and SC-4 require systematic audit of every REVIEW-DEFENSE annotation with disposition routing.

**Scope**: tests/test-audit-review-defenses.sh with fixtures covering: (a) REVIEW-DEFENSE in production script citing still-present pattern, (b) referencing deleted function (stale), (c) saying 'not wired yet — see epic XXXX-YYYY' (walking-skeleton), (d) in test file annotating RED-phase assertion, (e) in test file annotating non-obvious assertion, (f) referencing closed ticket (deferral candidate).
- tests/test-audit-review-defenses.sh exists, is executable, runs via test-batched.sh
- Fixtures cover 6 enumerated cases + at least one no-match negative case
- Tests assert defense_kind classifications (production, test-red, test-non-obvious, walking-skeleton)
- Tests assert status field (still-defended, stale, needs-followon-check, deferral-complete)
- Tests FAIL because plugins/dso/scripts/audit-review-defenses.sh does not exist
